risks.description: Coarse grid CFD simulations producing pre-asymptotic oscillatory results
risks.mitigation: Enforce ASME V&V 20-2009 strict GCI checks and reject monotonic claims when R < 0.

risks.description: Electrothermal runaway under positive temperature coefficient resistors at high voltages
risks.mitigation: Picard under-relaxation (factor 0.7) and fail-closed max temperature abort guards in ElectrothermalSolver.

risks.description: Stale multidomain evidence reuse across modified geometry or component parameters
risks.mitigation: Cryptographic SHA-256 canonical hashing across all model components; any input change invalidates cached evidence.
